name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou: Toki no Sugiyuku Mama ni
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 時の過ぎゆくままに
source:
The fourth game in the Jake Hunter/Tantei Jingūji Saburō series, the second on a regular Famicom cartridge, and the last for the Famicom. There is a burglary at a mansion, which Jake goes to investigate. He sends his assistant Yulia Marks to search for the home of a young boy. While both cases seem simple on their own, they get more complicated when they become one.

[From [url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/tantei-jingji-sabur-toki-no-sugiyuku-mama-ni]mobygames[/url]]
translation:
杰克·亨特／神宫寺三郎系列第四作，第二部登陆普通FC卡带，也是FC平台的最后一作。一座宅邸发生盗窃，杰克前往调查。他派助手由莉娅·马克斯寻找一名男孩的住所。两起案件单独看似乎都很简单，却在交汇后变得更加复杂。

[来源：[url=http://www.mobygames.com/game/tantei-jingji-sabur-toki-no-sugiyuku-mama-ni]MobyGames[/url]]
